title: WooCommerce store
description: A WooCommerce store. All checks run, including those that read the WooCommerce Store API and the WordPress REST API. Checks for other platforms do not run.

title: Other store
description: Any other online store. Checks for the recognised platform run. Checks that need the WooCommerce Store API do not.

title: Content site
description: A site that sells nothing. Only the ingestion checks run: commerce sections, product-page checks and the product sitemap check do not apply, and neither do the legal signals about selling (withdrawal, returns, product and price information).
